name: org.jobopportunitiesapi/mcp
description: Search live employer-direct job postings, company hiring signal, market stats and the change feed.
title: JOA — Job Opportunities API

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <JOA API key>. Required for search_jobs, get_job, company_hiring's full roster, and changes_since. Not required for market_signals or coverage (keyless statistics). Get a free Explore key (1,000 records/month, no card) at https://jobopportunitiesapi.org/login?ref=mcp.
